dogecoin.text: Aspiring bank (deliberately snarky) @RevolutApp now supports Dogecoin, confirming my earlier scoop (below). https://t.co/tXEXirRWYA

Scoop: Crypto art collector @PleasrDAO - the group that splashed millions of dollars on an NFT of the image that inspired Dogecoin and on a rare Wu-Tang Clan album - is raising $69 million. Sources say the raise will value the DAO at around $1bn.
